name: factory
summary: One-way converter that constructs models from raw input data (API responses, rows, JSON).
description: Creates a factory class that builds a model from raw array data
problem: Raw data arrives in external shapes — API responses, database rows, decoded JSON — and you need a single, well-named place that validates, converts types, and constructs the clean model. One direction only: data in, model out.
appliesWhen: You're converting external or raw data into a model
The same model is created from multiple data sources with different shapes
Field names or types need transformation during construction (dates, enums, casts)
You want construction logic out of the model itself — models hold data, factories build them
avoidWhen: You need both directions (model back out to the external format) — that's an adapter (phpnomad/model-adapter)
Construction happens in many optional steps with intermediate state — that's a builder
The input already matches the constructor exactly — instantiate the model directly
You're constructing services or infrastructure objects — that's DI wiring, not a data factory

laravel: model factory (shape only, not fake data)

examples: Create a factory that builds Task models from API responses
I need to turn WordPress posts into Task objects
Hydrate an Order from a database row
Convert webhook JSON into a typed model
tradeoffs: One small file. Simpler than an adapter because it only converts one way — if you later need the reverse direction, migrate to phpnomad/model-adapter rather than bolting a toArray() onto the factory.
outputs: A {name} factory class with a fromArray() conversion method returning {model}
postApply: Map input fields to constructor arguments using Arr::get() for safe access
Rename fromArray (or add sibling methods) per data source: fromApiResponse, fromDatabaseRow, ...
Extract repeated type conversions (dates, enums) into private helper methods
Handle missing or null input gracefully — validate required fields

model.description: FQCN of the model class this factory constructs
model.aiHint: Use the FQCN of the model class (created by phpnomad/model). Convention is {rootNamespace}\Models\{ModelName}.
